table.outlineNote: convex hull of the lit table top (luma > 22, rows 455-620) simplified to 6 vertices, x,y in units of the top width, y down from the top-most point; the back edge is hidden by the cake and children and is cut at row 455
table.belowNote: mean luma under the table top (y 640-715): the base is not visible; legs/pedestal are dark or absent
table.heightNote: INFERRED: table top at about 0.56 of a standing child height, from the right child at 155 s (crown to table-top line 330 px, standing height estimated at 6 head-heights, 750 px); a size ratio only
table.heightToWidthNote: INFERRED: 0.56 x the right child standing height (750 px est.) over the top width (685 px) at 155 s
table.elevationNote: INFERRED: the projected flat-to-flat depth (158 px) over 0.866 x the vertex width (685 px) gives about 15 degrees for a regular hexagon, ignoring perspective
